description: Blind at Scale D-FB: feedback verification on real Spark. The 7 fixable GT-FAIL pipelines on zipf_s101 (G_A, G_N, J_A, J_N, F_A, F_B, W_A): run ORIGINAL then REWRITTEN, measuring both loads by the D8 method at T=200,000. Includes the salt-determinism check (G_A salted twice, loads must match exactly) and the ~10% subset output-equivalence spot check for G_A/J_A (--sample-outeq; best-effort, not the 48/48 outeq proof). Fresh dataset generation in this arm's own volume subdir (no dataset shared between arms). max_retries 0: a retry would double-bill and muddy provenance.
name: bas-d-fb-RUN_TAG
